newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ING Barings ups Volker Stevin estimates.
newsitem.headline: ING Barings ups Volker Stevin estimates.

text.p: COMMENT: Buy (unchanged). Good H1 figures, EPS should rise 15 pct. Dream Dutch contract won involving infrastructure and housing. Group is well focused on domestic market with no debt and ample cash to grow further through acquisitions.

Note -- The earnings per share forecasts differ from ones issued previously as they now reflect fully diluted figures. In the first half of the year some 20,000 shares were issued as a consequence of conversion of bonds. Total conversion would raise the number of shares by 15 percent. Non-diluted estimates of earnings per share for the years 1996, 1997 and 1998 would be 13.15, 14.00 and 15.15 guilders respectively, ING Barings said.
